components.name: Appfunctions
components.detailsHtml:
New Features

  • Version bump to RC and remove legacy aggregation compiler option.

components.name: Camera
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an UnsupportedOperationException on API 30 when apps with SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW repeatedly bind camera use cases. (I3235c, b/575161911)

  • Fixed a native thread leak when unbinding VideoCapture, which left one media framework thread behind per bind. (If5730, b/573671138)

components.name: Compose Foundation
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Modifier.border now consistently uses the outline size when rendering borders. Use ComposeFoundationFlags.isBorderMatchesOutlineBoundsFixEnabled to temporarily disable this if it causes issues. (I3e171)

components.name: Compose Material 3
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Resolve hardcoded pressed shape in ToggleButton to use design token ButtonSmallTokens.PressedContainerShape. (Ia60dc, b/531792521)
  • Fixed RangeSlider not updating values on tap when thumbs overlap. (I91d42, b/352467346)
  • Fixed floating-point precision loss in discrete Slider and RangeSlider when snapping to integer ticks. (I91d42, b/237634010)
  • Fixed RangeSlider inside a horizontally scrollable container scrolling the container when dragging a thumb. (I91d42, b/415838608)

components.name: Compose Remote
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Renamed Action to RemoteAction in remote-creation-compose and updated action factories and touch/click modifiers (clickable, onTouchDown, onTouchUp, onTouchCancel). (I19913)
  • Reordered RemoteShape.createOutline and RemoteCornerBasedShape.createOutline parameters to (size, layoutDirection, density) to match Compose Shape.createOutline. (Ifb87a)
  • Decoupled RemoteColor from Compose UI Color: RemoteColor now extends BaseRemoteState<Int> (ARGB @ColorInt) with Int.rc and @ColorInt factory overloads; Compose Color conversions (Color.rc, Color.asRemoteColor(), RemoteColor.asConstantColor()) remain available as extensions. (Ib31ea)
  • Added currentProfileSupportsPathClip() to check whether the current Remote Compose creation profile supports clipping to a path. (I3b0ab)
  • Deprecated rememberMutableRemote* factory functions (rememberMutableRemoteBoolean, rememberMutableRemoteEnum, rememberMutableRemoteFloat, rememberMutableRemoteImageBitmap, rememberMutableRemoteInt, and rememberMutableRemoteString) in remote-creation-compose in favor of remember { MutableRemote*(initialValue) }. (Ifb1f8)
  • Removed RemoteTypeface.toAndroidTypeface() and RemoteTypeface.Companion.fromAndroidTypeface() from remote-creation-compose. (I8867e)
  • Removed the previously deprecated RemoteModifier.animationSpec modifier. (I1aea8)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed chained RemoteModifier.drawWithContent modifiers dropping inner draw blocks (such as component container backgrounds when callers attach drawWithContent). (If7e75)

components.name: Compose Remote Foundation
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Renamed remoteBitmap to bitmap on RemoteBasicImage and moved style to the final parameter on RemoteBasicText to match Compose Foundation. (I2b57a)

components.name: Compose Runtime
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Updated androidx.tracing:tracing-wire dependency to 2.0.5. (I70e9f)

components.name: Coordinatorlayout
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Added a CoordinatorLayout.Behavior#onRequestChildRectangleOnScreen overload that provides the request source to Behaviors and updated compileSdk to API 36.1 (Ibddfd)
  • Removing obsolete @RequiresApi(21) annotations (Ic4792)

Bug Fixes

  • Moving the default minSdk from API 21 to API 23 (Ibdfca, b/380448311, b/435705964, b/435705223)

components.name: Core
components.detailsHtml:
Important Changes since 1.0.0

  • Updated accessibility APIs to match the Android 10 platform accessibility APIs
  • Added improvements to Nested Scrolling; see NestedScrollingChild3 and NestedScrollingParent3.
  • This library no longer exposes the androidx.collection dependency as part of its API. If you were depending on the androidx.collection types implicitly through a dependency on Core, you will need to add an explicit androidx.collection dependency to your library or app. This change is source-incompatible but retains binary compatibility. The Collection dependency is still a transitive dependency of Core but as an implementation detail instead of part of its API.
  • Worked around an IPC compatibility issue caused by refactor to androidx (aosp/948725, aosp/938269)
  • Added a variety of fixes for AppCompat DayNight (aosp/942956)

components.name: Enterprise
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Merged public and experimental API files for d,e,f,g-paths (I03646, b/278769092)

Bug Fixes

  • Moving the default minSdk from API 21 to API 23 (Ibdfca, b/380448311, b/435705964, b/435705223)
  • This library now uses JSpecify nullness annotations, which are type-use. Kotlin developers should use the following compiler arguments to enforce correct usage: -Xjspecify-annotations=strict, -Xtype-enhancement-improvements-strict-mode (I3d340, b/326456246)
  • Fixed a ClassCastException or NullPointerException that could occur in KeyedAppStatesService when processing received application states. I6909a28a

components.name: Glance Adaptive
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Added GlanceAdaptiveWidgetReceiver base AppWidgetProvider class as the main entry point for Glance Adaptive widgets. (Iddecc)
  • Added @integer/glance_adaptive_widget_category_all_known resource for <appwidget-provider>'s android:widgetCategory declaration, to opt in into all supported Widget surfaces. (I4582e)

components.name: Glance Wear
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Glance Wear now throws WearWidgetContentTooLargeException with actionable guidance when a widget's content is too large to be sent to the host (for example due to large bitmaps in RemoteImage), instead of failing with an obscure Binder error. (I9eb1c)
  • Added WearWidgetConfigExtras with helper to extract widget configuration parameters and moved constants from GlanceWearWidget to WearWidgetConfigExtras. (I70561)
  • Added GlanceWearProfiles.createWearWidgetsProfile(WearWidgetParams) to create a profile configured with the host-supported operations. (I51f28)
  • Exposed horizontalPaddingDp, verticalPaddingDp, and cornerRadiusDp in WearWidgetParams. (I19925)

Additional changes

  • Changes to use newly aligned parameter names and order across Remote Compose library.(I2e164)
  • Wear Widgets can now use the onTouchDown, onTouchUp and onTouchCancel modifiers on all Wear OS devices that support widgets, not only on devices with the latest widget renderer. Use them to show press feedback, such as a pressed state on a button. (I6dce7)
  • Added the MODIFIER_TOUCH_DOWN, MODIFIER_TOUCH_UP and MODIFIER_TOUCH_CANCEL operations to the Wear Widgets profile (GlanceWearProfiles), so widgets can use onTouchDown, onTouchUp and onTouchCancel on hosts that support them. (Id4a9a)

components.name: Ink
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Add experimental Ink APIs for calculating/storing phase offsets for strokes with animated textures (I620e6)
  • Add experimental Ink brush APIs for specifying an animated paint texture (If0f10)
  • Stroke shape (PartitionedMesh) serialization, to save partially erased strokes or to speed up document load times by saving mesh data (I1604f)

Bug Fixes

  • Fixed handling of concurrent inputs, and improved barrel twist compatibility. (I0fc23)

components.name: Input
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Support stylus AXIS_RZ in motion event predictor (I04f3a)

components.name: Navigation3
components.detailsHtml:
Changes

  • compileSdk has been downgraded from 37 to 36. Version 1.2 depends on Compose 1.10 which does not require compileSdk 37.

components.name: Navigation3
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Fix shared NavEntry not rendered on screen when it is popped then pushed again before the pop completes. (I6a482)

components.name: Test Backup
components.detailsHtml:
New Features

  • Added StorageDomain.DataStorePreference to seed and verify Preferences DataStore entries, StorageDomain.CustomData to run custom device actions, and StorageDomain.ExcludedData to verify that excluded data is not restored. (If127d, I6190e)
  • Added isDeviceProtectedStorage across StorageDomain types to test Device Protected (DE) storage, and added support for String Set values in StorageDomain.Preference. (Ie96be)
  • Added a restoreOn parameter to runBackupRestoreFlow for cross-device restore flows, BackupRestoreController.uninstallApp(), and minApi and maxApi bounds on @Device. (Ifa0e3)
  • Added testApplicationId and a default applicationId to @BackupRestoreConfig, and registered BackupRestoreTestRunner with InstrumentationRegistry for device actions. (Ie96be, Ifa0e3)
  • Updated BackupRestoreExtension to automatically save device logs when a test fails and report the saved file paths in the failure message (disable via androidx.test.backup.device.logs.enabled=false). (I7f605)

API Changes

  • Added BackupActionResult.data and BackupActionResult.getOrThrow() to read output payloads from device actions, along with STORAGE_TYPE_DATASTORE_PREFS, VALUE_TYPE_DOUBLE, and VALUE_TYPE_BYTES on BackupActionValues. (I6190e, If127d)
  • Removed BackupDeviceAction.phase, PHASE_POPULATE, and PHASE_VERIFY (remove the phase override from custom actions), as well as the BackupRestoreExtension(AdbSession) constructor. (Ie96be, I1a349)

components.name: Test Uiautomator
components.detailsHtml:
Bug Fixes

  • Fixed an issue in ShellServer where random port selection could lead to port collisions and startup failures. (I1951b)

components.name: Wear Compose
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Integrate material3-ripple in Wear material3 and add support for inset focus rings, introduce LocalRippleThemeConfiguration and RippleThemeConfiguration to support configuring focus indication, and deprecate RippleConfiguration.rippleAlpha. (Ifb63a)
  • Added LocalTimeSource to allow overriding TimeText's time source via CompositionLocal in tests and previews. (Ic981a)
  • Added Modifier.suppressStatusBar() to allow screens and components to suppress the status bar and automatically collapse top status bar insets. Removed the unreleased StatusBarSuppression() composables; use Modifier.suppressStatusBar() instead. (I0a0d6)

Bug Fixes

  • Dialog now only uses a full-screen offscreen layer while it is animating or being swiped, reducing GPU memory usage while it is shown and idle. (I65baf)
  • Fixed an issue where state written from a background thread while TransformingLazyColumn was measuring could be lost. (I3ed10)
  • Fixed a bug in OneHandedGestureDefaults.scrollDownToNextItem so that the first double pinch gesture always scrolls down, even when the list is at the top and the first item sits below the anchor point.

components.name: Wear Compose Remote
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Aligned RemoteButton, RemoteCompactButton (including defaulting label to null), RemoteIconButton, RemoteTextButton, RemoteEdgeButton, RemoteCheckboxButton, RemoteRadioButton, RemoteSwitchButton, RemoteTitleCard, RemoteOutlinedCard, RemoteCardDefaults.outlinedCardBorder, RemoteHorizontalPageIndicator, RemoteVerticalPageIndicator, and RemoteText parameter order, types, and names with Wear Compose Material 3, adopting RemoteBorderStroke for button borders and indicatorSize (RemotePageIndicatorDefaults.IndicatorSize) for page indicators. (If09ff)
  • Updated action callbacks (onClick, onCheckedChange, onSelect, onContainerClick, and onSelectionClick) across remote-material3 components to use RemoteAction instead of Action. (I19913)
  • Reordered RemoteEdgeButtonShape.createOutline parameters to (size, layoutDirection, density) to match RemoteShape.createOutline and Compose Shape.createOutline. (Ifb87a)
  • Added copy() to RemoteProgressIndicatorColors and RemoteShapes, made copy() parameters non-nullable across *Colors and *Shapes classes, removed @Composable from non-theme shape properties on *Defaults objects, removed the redundant RemoteEdgeButtonDefaults.shape property (use RemoteEdgeButtonDefaults.shape(buttonSize)), and renamed constants on RemotePageIndicatorDefaults and RemoteTimeTextDefaults to PascalCase. (Iae170)
  • Removed DefaultRemotePageIndicatorState and RemoteModifier.buttonSizeModifier() from the public API. (I3ada2)
  • Added a required defaultFontFamily parameter to the RemoteTypography(Typography) constructor to apply a RemoteFontFamily to every style. Pass RemoteFontFamily.Default for the previous behavior. (I34646)

Bug Fixes

  • RemoteButton, RemoteCompactButton, RemoteIconButton, and RemoteTextButton now clip their container backgrounds to custom RemoteShape outlines when the creation profile supports path clipping. (I3b0ab)
  • RemoteTimeText now defaults its color to onBackground with luminance 80, matching Wear Compose Material 3 TimeText. (Ib53fc)
  • RemoteSplitCheckboxButton now draws the same check mark and check animation as RemoteCheckboxButton. (I96f9f)
  • RemoteSplitSwitchButton now mirrors the switch thumb in right-to-left layouts and draws the same thumb check mark as RemoteSwitchButton. (I686ec)
  • Fixed RemoteButtonDefaults.containerPainter and RemoteCardDefaults.containerPainter ignoring alpha and disabledContainerOpacity, and aligned RemoteIconButtonDefaults contentColor defaults with Wear Compose Material 3. (I9c5fb)
  • RemoteCheckboxButton, RemoteSwitchButton, and RemoteRadioButton now tint their icon with the icon colors from their colors, which default to the primary color, matching Wear Compose Material 3. (I31590)
  • Remote selection buttons and their split variants now animate their container and content colors with the slow effects spec of RemoteMaterialTheme.motionScheme, matching Wear Compose Material 3, and the RemoteCheckboxButton tick no longer rotates while being unchecked. (I822aa)
  • RemoteCircularProgressIndicator and RemoteLinearProgressIndicator now animate progress changes with RemoteMaterialTheme.motionScheme, matching Wear Compose Material 3, and RemoteCircularProgressIndicator now coerces progress into 0f..1f. The indeterminate RemoteCircularProgressIndicator now uses the standard easing for its trims. (Ief8ea)
  • Aligned default colors in RemoteButtonDefaults, RemoteCardDefaults.outlinedCardBorderColor, RemoteCheckboxButtonDefaults, and RemotePageIndicatorDefaults with Wear Compose Material 3. (I87510)

components.name: Web
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • WebContent: Introducing a new API to hold a persistent web engine session state that can safely outlive individual UI views or Activities. (I41397)
  • WebContentView: Introducing a new specialized WebView designed to integrate with WebContent. (I41397)
  • DetachedWebContentView: A specialized WebContentView that WebContent attaches to when not attached to an Activity. (I41397)

components.name: Webkit
components.detailsHtml:
API Changes

  • Fix accidental hidden callback on NavigationListener (I1cd2e, b/576625538)
  • Added an overload of WebViewCompat#startUpWebView that accepts an Executor on which to invoke the WebViewOutcomeReceiver callback, allowing applications to handle startup completion on a background thread rather than the main looper. (I51748)
  • Changed Navigation/Page#snapshotState to #captureState and edited NavigationState#didCommitErrorPage javadoc (I0405a)

  • Adds NavigationState and PageState which are immutable copies of Navigation and Page at a certain point in time. They are supplied via new callbacks within NavigationListener, which have NavigationState and PageState as parameters instead of Navigation and Page. The state objects can also be supplied by Navigation#snapshotState and Page#snapshotState.

  • Added NavigationState#getNavigationStartUptimeMillis which returns the navigation's start up time in milliseconds.

  • Added NavigationState#getResponseHeaders and NavigationRedirectParameters which is supplied via onNavigationRedirect(NavigationState,NavigationRedirectParameters) which exposes the HTTP response headers for the Navigation. (I9886a)

  • Added support for Profile#addQuicHints to take wildcards as URLs (such as https://*.example.com or `https://*) (Ic6d67, b/442161273)

  • Deprecated WebSettingsCompat.getAttributionRegistrationBehavior, WebSettingsCompat.setAttributionRegistrationBehavior, and related constants as WebView no longer supports Attribution Reporting in version 152 and later. (I3453a, b/528282384)
